headline: LeviLauncher Modder v1.6.1-modder.37
summary: The update screen got a Material 3 Expressive pass: two tonal cards with 28dp corners, a bold headline with version and size as pill chips, notes that scroll inside their own surface, pill actions and a spring entrance.

items.text: The release notes page was a flat two-column layout: the download badge floated on the bare background, the notes ran edge to edge and the left half sat mostly empty. It is now two rounded tonal cards — a hero card with the badge, a bold headline and the version and size shown as pill chips, and a notes card that scrolls inside its own surface. The actions are pill buttons with a wider primary button, and both cards spring into place instead of popping.

On a short landscape screen the hero card could push its content past the card edge while a download was running. The hero stack now scrolls inside the card, staying centred while it fits and scrolling when it does not.
